bds.lede: The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.
rows: BBC News
The defeated Brazilian candidate claims to be the victim of a coup d’état and political persecution, recycling unsubstantiated allegations of “electoral fraud”.
PBS NewsHour

Another member of Brazil's Bolsonaro family has found haven from possible prosecution by fleeing to the U.S., where they have an ally in President Trump. Just three days after losing Brazil’s presidential election, Flávio Bolsonaro, who faces multiple criminal investigations, defied a Brazilian…

Far-right senator and family land in US after crossing from Brazil into Argentina and then flying via Ecuador

Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family landed in Miami on Wednesday after fleeing Brazil.

Defeated Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family arrived in Miami on Wednesday after he refused to concede the election to President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and fled the country.

Flávio Bolsonaro, who lost Brazil's presidential election, left the country with his family and State Department official told CBS News they would receive U.S. visas.

bds.h: Shock, anger and mourning in Spain after 2nd major train crash this year
bds.lede: There is shock, anger and mourning in Spain after the second fatal train crash this year. At least 68 people have died in what is now the deadliest collision there in more than a decade. William Brangham reports.
rows: PBS NewsHour

There is shock, anger and mourning in Spain after the second fatal train crash this year. At least 68 people have died in what is now the deadliest collision there in more than a decade. William Brangham reports.
BBC News
The crash, between a moving train and another that was stopped further up the track, was caused by an "inexplicable" error, the transport minister said.
CTV News
Six Canadians were injured and one is unaccounted for after a high-speed rail crash Wednesday in Spain, Global Affairs Canada said in a statement.
The Guardian
Pedro Sánchez says the government will act with urgency to ‘clarify what has happened, why this tragedy occurred’
Toronto Star
One train slammed into another that had stopped on the tracks in Spain. Officials reported at least 68 people killed, and another 58 were receiving treatment at local hospitals.
CBC News
A high-speed train slammed into another that had stopped on the tracks in Spain Wednesday, killing at least 68 people and injuring dozens in the second deadly rail collision this year.

bds.h: Tributes pour in for labor leader Dolores Huerta: ‘Fought for farm workers to the very end’
bds.lede: Lawmakers, activists and union leaders across the US remember the co-founder of United Farm Workers union
rows: The Guardian
Lawmakers, activists and union leaders across the US remember the co-founder of United Farm Workers union
ABC News
Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers, has died at 96, her family said.
CBS News
Labor and civil rights activist Dolores Huerta has died at 96. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe has more on that and on the state of midterm races in Alaska.
PBS NewsHour
Dolores Huerta, the pioneering labor leader and civil rights icon, died Wednesday from cancer at her home in Bakersfield, California. Amna Nawaz looks back at Huerta's life and legacy.
CBC News

Dolores Huerta, who co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in fruit and vegetable fields in the United States and coined the enduring "Sí, se puede!" rallying cry, has died. She was 96.
BBC News
Huerta fought for farm workers' rights in the 1960s and 1970s and had continued to work addressing immigration and voting issues.
